source: feature/transcript-web (stream T2): the shared web transcript viewer of both portals
rule: frontend/lib/transcript/** and frontend/components/transcript/** are byte-identical in both portals (shared/transcript-web.sha256, scripts/sync_transcript_web.py). A file there may import only another file of the two trees (by @/ path or relatively), the packages listed in 'packages', and the app modules in 'modules', which both portals carry with the same exports. frontend/e2e/transcript-web-imports-unit.spec.ts fails on anything else.
